article_summary: What each line on your invoice means, when you are charged, and how to read your billing history.
section_text: Subscriptions renew on the same day each month. The charge appears on your statement within one business day of renewal.

article_summary: What each line on your invoice means, when you are charged, and how to read your billing history.
section_text: Each invoice lists the plan, the number of seats, taxes, and any credits applied. Download past invoices as PDF from the Billing page.

article_summary: What each line on your invoice means, when you are charged, and how to read your billing history.
section_text: A pending charge is a temporary authorization hold from your bank. It disappears within a few days if the payment does not go through.

article_summary: How to get your money back after a duplicate charge, a cancelled order, or a payment you did not expect.
section_text: If you see two identical charges, one is usually a pending authorization that drops off on its own. If both are still there after three days, contact us and we will refund the duplicate.

article_summary: How to get your money back after a duplicate charge, a cancelled order, or a payment you did not expect.
section_text: Refunds go back to the original payment method. Cards usually show the money within 5 to 7 business days, bank transfers can take up to 10.

article_summary: How to get your money back after a duplicate charge, a cancelled order, or a payment you did not expect.
section_text: Open the order in your billing history and choose Request refund. Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase.

article_summary: Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription, and what happens to your data when you do.
section_text: Upgrades take effect immediately. You pay only the prorated difference for the rest of the current billing period.

article_summary: Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription, and what happens to your data when you do.
section_text: Downgrades start at the next renewal date. Features that are not part of the new plan become read only.

article_summary: Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription, and what happens to your data when you do.
section_text: Cancel any time from the Billing page. Your workspace stays available until the end of the period you already paid for.

article_summary: Fix problems logging in, reset a forgotten password, and set up two-factor authentication.
section_text: Click Forgot password on the sign-in page and we will email you a reset link. The link expires after one hour.

article_summary: Fix problems logging in, reset a forgotten password, and set up two-factor authentication.
section_title: Locked out after too many attempts
section_text: After five failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes to protect it. Wait, then try again or reset your password.

article_summary: Fix problems logging in, reset a forgotten password, and set up two-factor authentication.
section_text: Turn on two-factor authentication in Security settings and scan the QR code with an authenticator app. Save the backup codes somewhere safe.

article_summary: Fix problems logging in, reset a forgotten password, and set up two-factor authentication.
section_text: If you lost the device with your authenticator app, sign in with a backup code, then set up two-factor authentication again on the new phone.

article_summary: Change your name, email address, and notification preferences.
section_text: Update your email in Profile settings. We send a confirmation link to the new address, and the change applies once you click it.

article_summary: Change your name, email address, and notification preferences.
section_text: Choose which emails you receive, such as weekly summaries, mentions, and product news. Security alerts cannot be turned off.

article_summary: Add teammates to your workspace, set their roles, and remove people who leave.
section_text: Admins can invite people by email from the Members page. Invitations expire after seven days and can be resent.

article_summary: Add teammates to your workspace, set their roles, and remove people who leave.
section_text: Members can edit projects, admins can also manage billing and members, and guests can only view the projects shared with them.

article_summary: Add teammates to your workspace, set their roles, and remove people who leave.
section_text: Removing a member frees their seat right away. Their projects are transferred to the admin who removed them.

article_summary: Steps to fix the desktop and mobile app when it crashes on launch, freezes, or runs slowly.
section_text: Make sure you are on the latest version, then restart your device. If it still crashes, reinstall the app; your data is stored in the cloud and will not be lost.

article_summary: Steps to fix the desktop and mobile app when it crashes on launch, freezes, or runs slowly.
section_text: Large projects with thousands of items can slow the app down. Archive old items and close unused tabs to speed it up.

article_summary: Steps to fix the desktop and mobile app when it crashes on launch, freezes, or runs slowly.
section_text: Go to Help, then Report a problem. The report includes logs that help our engineers find the cause faster.

article_summary: How changes sync between devices, working without an internet connection, and fixing sync conflicts.
section_text: The app keeps working without a connection. Your changes are saved on the device and upload automatically when you are back online.

article_summary: How changes sync between devices, working without an internet connection, and fixing sync conflicts.
section_title: Changes not showing on another device
section_text: Sync usually takes a few seconds. If a change is missing, check both devices are signed in to the same workspace and pull down to refresh.

article_summary: How changes sync between devices, working without an internet connection, and fixing sync conflicts.
section_text: When the same item was edited on two devices while offline, we keep both versions and ask you which one to keep.

article_summary: Bring data in from spreadsheets and other tools, and export your workspace as CSV or JSON.
section_text: Upload a CSV or Excel file from the Import page. Map each column to a field, preview the result, then confirm.

article_summary: Bring data in from spreadsheets and other tools, and export your workspace as CSV or JSON.
section_text: Admins can export the whole workspace as CSV or JSON from Settings. Large exports are emailed as a download link.

article_summary: Bring data in from spreadsheets and other tools, and export your workspace as CSV or JSON.
section_text: Create an API key in Developer settings to read and write data from your own scripts. Keys can be revoked at any time.

article_summary: What data we store, how to download a copy of it, and how to delete your account.
section_text: We store your account details, workspace content, and usage logs. We never sell personal data to third parties.

article_summary: What data we store, how to download a copy of it, and how to delete your account.
section_text: Request a copy of your personal data from Privacy settings. We prepare an archive and email you a link within 48 hours.

article_summary: What data we store, how to download a copy of it, and how to delete your account.
section_text: Deleting your account removes your profile and personal data within 30 days. Workspaces you own must be transferred or deleted first.
